newsitem.title: USA: Miami sets tourism record for 1997 first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Miami sets tourism record for 1997 first quarter.

text.p: A record 2.8 million overnight visitors arrived in the urban Miami area in the first quarter of 1997, an increase of 2.8 percent or 76,700 visitors over the same period last year, tourism officials said.

Tourists pumped $3.4 billion into the local economy during the quarter, a 15 percent increase over the same quarter last year, according to a report released Wednesday by Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau.
"The increase is the result of expanded marketing programs, an improved hotel product, better customer service and a revitalized infrastructure," said bureau President Merrett Stierheim.

The domestic market increased 4.6 percent to 1.5 million visitors between Jan 1 and March 31. International tourism to the area grew to 1.3 million, an increase of 0.9 percent over first quarter 1996.
